_doc: Per-repo editor/agent dotfiles, built and deployed with the same src → build.sh → dist → target shape as 1_workflows. Adding a tool = one entry in `targets` plus a directory under src/dotfiles/. Nothing here is machine-specific: see `never_manage`.
_portability: This module is designed to be copied verbatim into any repo (unix, tools, front-data, ...). It has no dependency on cloud's TypeScript engines — build.sh's `dotfiles` verb is plain POSIX file copying, so a repo needs only 2_configs/src/dotfiles/ + the verb.
_never_manage_doc: Per-machine state, NOT configuration. .obsidian/workspace*.json holds pane ids and layout for one device; .claude/settings.local.json is the documented place for local overrides. Deploy copies file-by-file and never purges the target directory, so these survive untouched — overwriting them would clobber another device's layout on every build.
_deploy_semantics: Additive per file. dist/dotfiles/<tool>/* is copied over <repo>/<target>/, creating the directory if needed. The target is NEVER emptied first (unlike 1_workflows' dist purge) precisely because these directories mix managed config with unmanaged machine state.
